items.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8 Foundation Model and Qianwen Office Agent, Reseating Itself in the Enterprise AI Race
items.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8 基座模型与千问办公智能体，重夺企业级 AI 竞争席位
items.summary: Alibaba unveiled the Qwen3.8 flagship foundation model with 2.4 trillion total parameters and 95B active parameters, alongside Qianwen Office for enterprise AI workflows. The base-model-plus-office strategy leverages DingTalk's enterprise moat against Tencent WorkBuddy and ByteDance Doubao.

items.title: ByteDance launches SeedRealtime full-duplex audio-video model
items.title_zh: 字节跳动发布 SeedRealtime 全双工音视频实时交互模型
items.summary: ByteDance launched SeedRealtime, a native full-duplex audio-video model that continuously processes audio, video and text streams while listening and responding in real time. The model has been rolled out in the Doubao app.

items.title: DeepSeek reportedly reopens talks on a RMB50 billion second funding round
items.title_zh: 消息称 DeepSeek 重启第二轮融资谈判，目标 500 亿元人民币
items.summary: DeepSeek has reportedly reopened talks for a second funding round targeting RMB50 billion, potentially valuing the Chinese AI company at about RMB500 billion before the financing. The talks could lead to an agreement in late August, but terms and timing have not been finalized.

items.title: Moonshot AI reportedly opens pre-IPO round at $50 billion valuation as Kimi K3 drives demand
items.title_zh: 月之暗面据报启动 500 亿美元估值 Pre-IPO 轮融资，Kimi K3 带动需求
items.summary: Moonshot AI, the Chinese developer of the Kimi chatbot, has reportedly opened a G-round pre-IPO financing at a valuation of $50 billion. A person familiar with the deal said investor interest intensified after the Kimi K3 launch.

items.title: Safety Risks Behind China's Top Open-Source LLMs: 76 percent Vulnerability Reproduction, Zero Refusal
items.title_zh: 中国顶级开源大模型安全风险：GLM-5.2 漏洞复现率 76%、零拒答
items.summary: An independent SaferAI audit of Zhipu's open-source GLM-5.2 found cyber-offense capability on par with GPT-5.5 but a complete absence of content-filtering guardrails, exposing structural risks for open-weight releases.

items.title: China Humanoid Robots in 2026: Production Boom Meets Deployment Reality Check as AgiBot and Unitree Lead
items.title_zh: 2026 中国人形机器人：产量爆发撞上落地现实，智元与宇树领跑
items.summary: MIIT projects 2026 humanoid robot output to exceed 100,000 units, with AgiBot and Unitree forming a duopoly at 15,000 and 11,000 units respectively. UBTech's shipment slippage and Unitree's 70% research-and-education revenue share highlight the gap between production and real deployment.

items.title: TSMC's 2nm monthly capacity to reach 100,000 wafers
items.title_zh: 台积电 2nm 月产能将达 10 万片晶圆
items.summary: Strong AI demand has pushed the world's largest foundry to expand 2nm production, with monthly capacity set to reach 100,000 wafers, according to Taiwan's Economic Daily News citing supply chain sources, as customers shift to 3nm and 2nm processes.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash tops OpenRouter weekly ranking with 7.22 trillion tokens
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 登顶 OpenRouter 周榜，处理 7.22 万亿 tokens
items.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash ranked first in OpenRouter's weekly model-usage ranking for July 27 to Aug. 2, processing 7.22 trillion tokens. On Aug. 1 the model handled 8 trillion tokens on OpenCode, including 5 trillion from free trials and 3 trillion paid by developers.

items.title: Google Assistant shutting down on Android and Wear OS in September
items.title_zh: Google Assistant 将于 9 月在 Android 与 Wear OS 上停运
items.summary: Google has set a September 4 shutdown date for Google Assistant on Android, confirming the assistant's widely expected phase-out in 2026 on Android and Wear OS.

items.title: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon
items.title_zh: SpaceX 剑指 T-Mobile、AT&T 与 Verizon，计划自建地面移动网络
items.summary: SpaceX is preparing to build a terrestrial mobile network to "acquire quite a few" of the customers now subscribed to T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon. The message was delivered by SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell and CEO Elon Musk during the Q&A of the company's first earnings call.

items.title: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon

items.title: Rust-lang/rust is adopting an LLM policy
items.title_zh: Rust 语言项目将采纳 LLM 使用政策
items.summary: The Rust programming language project announced it is adopting an official LLM policy formalizing how large language models may be used in project development (Hacker News, 38 points, 13 comments).

items.title: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: Zero-Mem：面向 LLM 智能体的零 Token 记忆操作研究
items.summary: An arXiv paper titled "Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents" proposes token-free memory operations for LLM agents, discussed on Hacker News (21 points, 4 comments).

items.title: An SLM trained on $8 ESP32-S3
items.title_zh: 用 8 美元的 ESP32-S3 训练小语言模型
items.summary: The qapla project demonstrates training a small language model on an $8 ESP32-S3 microcontroller, shared on Hacker News (16 points, 6 comments).

items.title: Flowise is shutting down
items.title_zh: Flowise 宣布停运
items.summary: Flowise, the open-source LLM workflow platform, announced it is shutting down via its sunset page, sparking discussion on Hacker News (41 points, 21 comments).

items.title: Wispr Flow launches a Granola-styled meeting notetaker
items.title_zh: Wispr Flow 推出类 Granola 的会议记录工具 Notetaker
items.summary: Wispr Flow's updated terms of service indicate it will introduce a meeting notetaker that generates meeting summaries and action items, entering the AI meeting-assistant market with its first product beyond dictation.

items.title: Think tank warns Europe's orbital compute gap is widening
items.title_zh: 智库警告：欧洲轨道计算差距正在扩大
items.summary: The European Space Policy Institute warns Europe risks becoming dependent on foreign orbital computing infrastructure as U.S. companies and China's government-led push accelerate the development of space-based data centers.

items.title: The Next Hundred-Billion-Dollar Robot Battlefield May Be the Kitchen
items.title_zh: 下一个千亿美元机器人战场可能是厨房
items.summary: Capital, home-appliance giants and humanoid-robot startups are all converging on the Chinese commercial kitchen, with one industry projection putting the AI cooking-robot market above 109.6 billion yuan by 2030.

items.title: China's Dexterous Hand New Top 4: From Demo to Mass Production, the First Tier Solidifies
items.title_zh: 中国灵巧手新四强：从演示走向量产，第一梯队成形
items.summary: Yinshi Robotics, Lingxin, LinJieDian and BrainCo form the new top tier as China's dexterous hand industry crosses the demo-to-mass-production threshold, with H1 2026 funding surpassing RMB25 billion and shipment forecasts reaching 70,200 units.

items.title: Embodied-AI data infrastructure startup Kaiwang Data raises more than RMB100 million
items.title_zh: 具身智能数据基础设施公司恺望数据完成超亿元融资
items.summary: Kaiwang Data, a Chinese provider of data infrastructure for embodied AI, completed a strategic funding round of more than RMB100 million, co-led by the Beijing E-Town Industrial Upgrade Fund, Huafang Capital and Skyline Capital, with several robotics companies also participating.

items.title: Samsung, SK Hynix reportedly evaluate Chinese AMEC tools for China fabs
items.title_zh: 三星与 SK 海力士据报评估中微公司设备用于中国工厂
items.summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are evaluating chipmaking equipment from China's Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment (AMEC) for possible use at their Chinese factories, according to three people familiar with the matter, as the memory makers hedge against tighter US controls on equipment shipments.

items.title: Chinese optical-module makers respond to reported US restrictions on imports
items.title_zh: 中国光模块厂商回应美国进口限制传闻
items.summary: Chinese optical-module makers responded to a report that the US FCC is drafting import restrictions on new Chinese data-center components including optical transceivers. Zhongji Innolight said no relevant FCC document had been issued, while Eoptolink said it was monitoring the situation and could not verify the report.

items.title: Glass Substrate Packaging Edges Toward Mass Production as Intel and Lens Technology Strike Strategic Alliance
items.title_zh: 玻璃基板封装走向量产：英特尔与蓝思科技达成战略合作
items.summary: Intel and Lens Technology signed a strategic alliance to accelerate glass substrate packaging, as Triassic and Tongge Micro push past the brittleness barrier. TGV yield, multi-layer RDL interconnect and scale cost control now define the next phase.

items.title: When Quantum Meets AI: Six Academicians Chart a New Blueprint for Smart Computing
items.title_zh: 当量子遇上 AI：六位院士勾勒智能计算新蓝图
items.summary: At the 5th CCF Quantum Computing Conference in Shenzhen, six CAS and CAE academicians outlined a national road map for AI-enabled quantum error correction and a unified quantum-supercomputing-AI infrastructure.
